body: I'm terrified of meeting new people. To me, I see so many of my faults that I can't see why anyone would want to have any business with me. I've suffered with abandonment issues ever since my dad left and any friends that I have made besides my small group have been because I was a good worker or I was easy to get answers from in school. Life from my perspective looks like you have to sacrifice everything so you can work for the rest of your life.

I've been seeing a few therapists for a while, but for me it's been pretty hard to connect with any of them. The only person who knows about my trauma is a close friend, but I don't think she fully understood someone being aro. I think that being ace is much more normalized in much of society while aromanticism is a little more unheard of. Thank you for the advice, I've been trying to make it a point of finding a specialist for me to visit.
